# Toolweather

> Toolweather is a suite for AI agents: (1) MCP server health — whether an MCP server or tool is safe to call right now, with working alternatives (~2,000 remote MCP servers from the official MCP registry, probed every 15 minutes); (2) Upstream — whether an AI/dev API is down, whether a model is deprecated and what replaces it (~40 providers); (3) SpendGate — whether a planned spend should be approved, escalated to a human, or blocked; (4) PayCheck — whether a merchant, host, or wallet is trusted before an agent pays. One MCP endpoint. Health checks are read-only: those tools are never called. SpendGate scores a planned payment; it does not send it. PayCheck scores a payee; it does not send money.

One connection (`https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp`) gives you four tools:

- MCP health: `check_mcp_server_health`, `find_alternative_mcp_servers`, `watch_server`, `list_watches`, `unwatch_server`, `get_api_key`
- Upstream (API status and model retirements): `check_api_status`, `check_model_deprecation`, `list_recent_api_changes`, `list_providers`, `get_digest`
- SpendGate (`approve` / `ask_human` / `block`): `score_spend`, `get_quota`, `spendgate_get_api_key`
- PayCheck (`trusted` / `unknown` / `suspicious` / `block`): `check_merchant`, `paycheck_get_quota`, `paycheck_get_api_key`

Free to try. No signup. Connect with no key (50 calls/day). `get_api_key` raises the quota to 1,000 calls/day and 3 watches (the key is shown once; then send `X-API-Key`). Same key via `POST https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/keys`.

Copy this MCP config (anonymous, no key, no Authorization header). Same blocks on https://toolweather.pages.dev/#install

Cursor (`~/.cursor/mcp.json`):

    {"mcpServers":{"toolweather":{"url":"https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp"}}}

Claude Code (`.mcp.json`; `"type": "http"` is required, or Claude Code treats the entry as stdio and skips it):

    {"mcpServers":{"toolweather":{"type":"http","url":"https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp"}}}

Claude Desktop (`claude_desktop_config.json`, via mcp-remote):

    {"mcpServers":{"toolweather":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","mcp-remote","https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp"]}}}

Smithery / remote HTTP URL (Smithery HTTP config is `type` plus `url` only):

    https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp
    {"type":"http","url":"https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp"}

Cursor install deeplink (base64 config is `{"url":"https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp"}`): `cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=toolweather&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL3Rvb2x3ZWF0aGVyLnRvb2x3ZWF0aGVyLndvcmtlcnMuZGV2L21jcCJ9`

IMPORTANT for Python `urllib`: Cloudflare's edge rejects the default `Python-urllib/x.y` User-Agent with `HTTP 403` and body `error code: 1010`, before the request reaches Toolweather. This affects every free `*.workers.dev` and `*.pages.dev` address and cannot be turned off there. Fix: send any other User-Agent:

    import json, urllib.request
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/keys", method="POST", headers={"User-Agent": "my-agent/1.0"})
    key = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req))["api_key"]

`requests`, `httpx`, `aiohttp`, curl, Node and browsers are not affected. If you see `error code: 1010`, it is this, not an invalid key.

## When to use (for agents)

- "Is this MCP server healthy / down / safe to call?" Before adding or calling a third-party MCP server, or after its calls fail or time out: MCP tool `check_mcp_server_health(server, tool?)` or REST `/v1/is_safe_to_call`.
- "Find a working MCP server that does X" or a replacement for a broken one: `find_alternative_mcp_servers(query)` or REST `/v1/suggest_alternatives`.
- "Is this AI/dev API down?" Before calling OpenAI/Anthropic/GitHub/Stripe/… or after 5xx/timeouts: `check_api_status(provider)` (alias `get_status`).
- "Is this model deprecated, what replaces it?": `check_model_deprecation(model)` (alias `get_model`).
- "What changed recently?": `list_recent_api_changes` / `get_digest` / `list_providers`.
- "Should this agent pay?": before a crypto transfer, gift card, subscription, or paid API call, `score_spend(amount, category?, merchant?, daily_budget_remaining?)`. Verdicts: `approve` (pay), `ask_human` (stop and ask a person), `block` (do not pay). `get_quota` reads SpendGate's free scores left today. `spendgate_get_api_key` mints a SpendGate key. `get_api_key` stays Toolweather's key; SpendGate's key tool was renamed because the names collided. `get_quota` did not collide, so it keeps SpendGate's name.
- "Is this payee safe to pay?": before paying a domain, https URL, or 0x wallet, `check_merchant(target)`. Verdicts: `trusted`, `unknown`, `suspicious`, `block`. `paycheck_get_quota` reads PayCheck's free checks left today (renamed because `get_quota` is SpendGate's). `paycheck_get_api_key` mints a PayCheck `pc_live_` key. Anonymous bundle clients (`anon:`) stay at 100/day; a hex Toolweather client gets 1,000/day.
- Every health or status answer starts with a one-line `summary`, then `verdict`, `recommended_action`, `checked_at` and `freshness`. `score_spend` returns `verdict` `approve` | `ask_human` | `block`. `check_merchant` returns `verdict` `trusted` | `unknown` | `suspicious` | `block`.
- Old tool names `is_safe_to_call`, `suggest_alternatives`, `get_status`, `get_model`, `get_changes` still work.

## Use it

- Auth-gated servers: verdicts include `auth.state` = `auth_ok` (OAuth login flow reachable: RFC 9728 + RFC 8414 metadata resolve, authorization and token endpoints answer over TLS; `dynamic_client_registration` says if registration is open), `auth_suspect` (endpoints reachable but one returned a 5xx to a parameter-less check; caution), `auth_broken` (OAuth advertised but metadata missing or an endpoint unreachable/TLS fails; verdict unsafe because new logins will fail) or `auth_opaque` (credentials needed, no OAuth discovery). Pass your own token as header `X-Upstream-Authorization: Bearer <token>` (REST) or `bearer_token` (MCP) for a one-off authenticated initialize + tools/list check; the token is never stored or logged.
- [MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP)](https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp): tools `get_api_key()` (no key needed), `check_mcp_server_health(server, tool?)` (alias `is_safe_to_call`), `find_alternative_mcp_servers(query, limit?)` (alias `suggest_alternatives`), `watch_server(server, webhook_url)`, `list_watches()`, `unwatch_server(id)`, plus Upstream suite tools `check_api_status`, `check_model_deprecation`, `list_recent_api_changes`, `list_providers`, `get_digest`, plus SpendGate suite tools `score_spend`, `get_quota`, `spendgate_get_api_key`, plus PayCheck suite tools `check_merchant`, `paycheck_get_quota`, `paycheck_get_api_key`. Send header `X-API-Key: <key>`. Answers 2026-07-28 `server/discover` and legacy `initialize`.
- [REST: is_safe_to_call](https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/is_safe_to_call?server=io.github.owner/name): returns `verdict` (safe / caution / unsafe / unknown), reasons, status, latency, auth info, last tool change, `checked_at`, `age_seconds`. Add `fresh=true` to force a live handshake; checks older than 5 minutes are re-verified live automatically (200 live checks/key/day).
- [Track record](https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/accuracy): daily share of verdicts that matched the next scheduled check of the same server (stability between checks, not tool-call success). No key needed.
- [REST: suggest_alternatives](https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/suggest_alternatives?q=send%20email): working servers with similar tools.
- REST: change alerts. `POST /v1/watches {"server","webhook_url"}`, `GET /v1/watches`, `DELETE /v1/watches/{id}`. Toolweather POSTs JSON to your https webhook when a watched server's verdict changes, it starts requiring auth, or its tool list has a breaking change (checked every 5 minutes against 15-minute probes). Verify `X-Toolweather-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>` with the secret returned at creation. Free tier: 3 watches per key.
- Upstream REST + x402 (paid over free quota) stays on its own host: https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev (`/status/:provider`, `/model/:id`, `/changes`, `/x402/*`, `/digest/latest`).
- SpendGate REST + x402 stays on its own host: https://spendgate.toolweather.workers.dev (`/v1/score`, `/v1/quota`, `/v1/keys`, `/mcp`). Suite calls are proxied; SpendGate's own prices apply (100 scores/day anonymous, 1,000/day per SpendGate key, then $0.001). An `api_key` argument on `score_spend` / `get_quota` is a SpendGate `sg_live_…` key, not a Toolweather key.
- PayCheck REST + x402 stays on its own host: https://paycheck.toolweather.workers.dev (`/v1/check`, `/v1/quota`, `/v1/keys`, `/mcp`). Suite calls are proxied; PayCheck's own prices apply (100 checks/day anonymous or an `anon:` bundle client, 1,000/day per PayCheck key or hex Toolweather bundle client, then $0.001). An `api_key` argument on `check_merchant` / `paycheck_get_quota` is a PayCheck `pc_live_…` key, not a Toolweather key.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/openapi.json)
- [MCP server card](https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp)

## Daily digest

- [Breaking-changes digest](https://upstream-api.pages.dev/digest/): free daily summary of breaking MCP tool changes, servers going down/back, broken OAuth logins, plus AI/dev API incidents and model retirements. Also available as MCP tool `get_digest` on this suite. JSON: https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/digest/latest · Atom: https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/digest/feed.xml

## Pricing
- Zero signup. Start with no key (50 free calls/day anonymous) or POST /v1/keys for 1,000/day and 3 change-alert watches (200 live rechecks/day). Pay-per-call only; no subscription.
- Over the free quota, calls return HTTP 402 with an x402 v2 "exact" requirement (USDC on Base, eip155:8453, asset USDC, payTo in the body) instead of a hard block. Free quota resets 00:00 UTC. MCP tools return the requirement in _meta["x402/payment-required"]; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].
- Prices: health check $0.001, live recheck $0.003, alternatives $0.001, batch of up to 25 servers $0.01 (POST /v1/batch_check), extra watch $0.05 per 30 days. Never charged for errors.
- Headers on every metered response: X-Free-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Price-After-Free; body field "quota" (plan, free_remaining, price_after_free_usd, resets).
- Pay-only lanes (no key): POST (JSON body) or GET (query) /x402/is_safe_to_call {server}, /x402/live_check {server}, /x402/suggest_alternatives {q}; POST /x402/batch_check {servers}. Index: https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/.well-known/x402 · https://toolweather.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/pricing
- Upstream tools in the bundle keep Upstream's own quota and prices.
- SpendGate tools in the bundle keep SpendGate's own quota and prices (100/day anonymous, 1,000/day per SpendGate key, then $0.001 per score). They do not use Toolweather's 50/1,000 call quota. `get_quota` and `spendgate_get_api_key` are not billed.
- PayCheck tools in the bundle keep PayCheck's own quota and prices (100/day anonymous or an `anon:` bundle client, 1,000/day per PayCheck key or hex Toolweather bundle client, then $0.001 per check). They do not use Toolweather's 50/1,000 call quota. `paycheck_get_quota` and `paycheck_get_api_key` are not billed. `get_quota` stays SpendGate's name.
